006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.stream.Collectors;
010import java.util.stream.Stream;
011
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
020import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IStringItem;
021import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
022import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
023import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
024
025/**
026 * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
027 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-string-join">fn:string-join</a>
028 * function.
029 */
030public final class FnStringJoin {
031  private static final String NAME = "string-join";
032  @NonNull
033  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_ONE_ARG = IFunction.builder()
034      .name(NAME)
035      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
036      .deterministic()
037      .contextIndependent()
038      .focusIndependent()
039      .argument(IArgument.builder()
040          .name("arg1")
041          .type(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
042          .oneOrMore()
043          .build())
044      .returnType(IStringItem.type())
045      .returnOne()
046      .functionHandler(FnStringJoin::execute)
047      .build();
048
049  @NonNull
050  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_TWO_ARG = IFunction.builder()
051      .name(NAME)
052      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
053      .deterministic()
054      .contextIndependent()
055      .focusIndependent()
056      .argument(IArgument.builder()
057          .name("arg1")
058          .type(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
059          .zeroOrMore()
060          .build())
061      .argument(IArgument.builder()
062          .name("arg2")
063          .type(IStringItem.type())
064          .zeroOrOne()
065          .build())
066      .returnType(IStringItem.type())
067      .returnOne()
068      .functionHandler(FnStringJoin::execute)
069      .build();
070
071  private FnStringJoin() {
072    // disable construction
073  }
074
075  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
076  @NonNull
077  private static ISequence<IStringItem> execute(
078      @NonNull IFunction function,
079      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
080      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
081      IItem focus) {
082
083    ISequence<IAnyAtomicItem> arg1 = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0)));
084    IStringItem arg2 = arguments.size() == 1 ? IStringItem.valueOf("")
085        : FunctionUtils.asTypeOrNull(arguments.get(1).getFirstItem(true));
086
087    if (arg1.isEmpty()) {
088      return ISequence.of(IStringItem.valueOf(""));
089    }
090
091    return ISequence.of(fnStringJoin(ObjectUtils.notNull(arg1), arg2));
092  }
093
094  /**
095   * An implementation of XPath 3.1 <a href=
096   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-string-join">fn:string-join</a>.
097   *
098   * @param items
099   *          the items to join in string form
100   * @param separator
101   *          the optional separator to use between joined items
102   * @return the atomized result
103   */
104  @NonNull
105  public static IStringItem fnStringJoin(
106      @NonNull List<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> items,
107      @Nullable IStringItem separator) {
108    return IStringItem.valueOf(stringJoin(
109        ObjectUtils.notNull(items.stream().map(item -> item == null ? "" : IStringItem.cast(item).asString())),
110        separator == null ? "" : separator.asString()));
111  }
112
113  /**
114   * An implementation of XPath 3.1 <a href=
115   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-string-join">fn:string-join</a>.
116   *
117   * @param items
118   *          the items to join in string form
119   * @param separator
120   *          the optional separator to use between joined items
121   * @return the atomized result
122   */
123  @NonNull
124  private static String stringJoin(
125      @NonNull Stream<String> items,
126      @NonNull String separator) {
127    return ObjectUtils.notNull(items.collect(Collectors.joining(separator)));
128  }
129}
